explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 140 lines/9353 characters to 92 lines/6189 characters: 34.3% fewer lines and 33.8% fewer characters. Six peripherals expand meaningful central nodes. Modular boundaries organize the central tree; command execution adds call relationships, history and transfers expose ownership, and anchors expose data dependencies. Positions use measured text widths and heights with gaps; all diagrams are connected and edge lines are 1-based.

Evidence is limited to the point definition, embedded sources in context.json, and seed.json. Peripheral details go beyond the seed: empty native gestures and deferred move layout in MappingDocumentController; lazy checkpoint validation and mutable transaction metadata in CanvasHistory; exact layout ordering and coordinate conversion in LineGrid; generation identity checks; and transfer behavior for unselected edges.

Source-grounded qualifications: CanvasHistory.openCanvasView only stashes when the requested view is already active, so opening does not always restore a fresh checkpoint. The seed's absolute checkpoint immutability wording is narrowed: linkTransaction and retireTransactions replace transaction metadata under existing checkpoint IDs. CanvasTransfer converts ALL source edges into jumps during move, including edges whose endpoints are both unselected; it checks both history boundaries even for copy. The workspace publication claim is presented as an external contract documented by canvasTransfer.ts, since the workspace implementation is absent. Similarly, checkpoint publication after validation does not establish rollback of every revision-helper effect during staging. The imported transfer-placement algorithm and revision-helper internals are not supplied and remain unspecified.

diagrams.ascii:
Canvas Commands and History
|-- MappingDocumentController: shared mutation facade
|   |-- Entry points
|   |   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
|   |   `-- mounted canvas may attach one editor driver: settle + undo/redo
|   |-- Command publication path
|   |   |-- settle pending live gesture before applyUpdate
|   |   |-- require expectedVersion == snapshot.version
|   |   |-- clone document + canvas; apply operations sequentially
|   |   |-- finish layout, reconcile links, prune contexts/alternatives and normalize views
|   |   `-- validate -> historyService.append -> publish controller snapshot -> notify listeners
|   |-- Operation families
|   |   |-- content: create, insert issued revision, patch, replace, apply revision
|   |   |-- composition: duplicate instance, move, group, collapse, remove, delete diagrams
|   |   |-- annotations: source mappings, jumps, highlights, presentation, agent context
|   |   |-- connections: edge-create, edge-update, edge-remove
|   |   `-- alternatives/reviews: store, select, review, apply and show side panels
|   `-- Transient selection/layout updates can avoid advancing history
|-- CanvasHistoryService: runtime ownership boundary
|   |-- controller holds a CanvasEditingContext handle
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService maps handle objects -> CanvasHistory in a WeakMap
|   |-- owns append, navigate, reset, fork, adopt, saved views and persistence access
|   `-- service and runtime handles are not saved in the canvas
|-- CanvasHistory: checkpoints bind composition to issued diagram revisions
|   |-- StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   |-- document: placement tree, connections, sections, jumps and presentation metadata
|   |   |-- diagramBindings: content/diagram ID -> exact issued revision ID
|   |   `-- view: personal state restored separately from composition
|   |-- append(document, view, correspondence)
|   |   |-- validate scene, connections, jumps, contexts, settings and revision references
|   |   |-- assert issued diagrams; retain bound revisions and required dependencies
|   |   |-- encode content anchors using revision nodeRefs
|   |   `-- publish checkpoint after validation completes
|   |-- documentFromHistory(checkpoint)
|   |   `-- bindings + revision table -> resolved contents + revision-specific anchors
|   |-- Navigation and branching
|   |   |-- undo: pop past -> head; previous head -> future
|   |   |-- redo: pop future -> head; previous head -> past
|   |   |-- edit after undo: append child of current head; clear redo route
|   |   |-- reset: copy baseline into a new checkpoint; reset itself is undoable
|   |   |-- fork: retain archive, create new context/baseline, clear past/future
|   |   `-- adopt: validate proposal, retain exact revision IDs, publish one new checkpoint
|   `-- Persistence and export
|       |-- persistenceChanges(since): navigation header + changed snapshots/revisions
|       |-- current-only export: real head ID + pinned dependencies + parent boundary IDs
|       `-- saved views or an active recording force full export to retain their graph
|-- LineGrid: reusable content and hierarchical placement are separate
|   |-- LineGridScene
|   |   |-- contents[contentId] -> reusable Diagram
|   |   `-- root -> GridBox tree
|   |       |-- diagram box -> contentId
|   |       `-- container -> children + push-right collision policy + gap
|   |-- Boxes carry relative cell position, collapse state and optional minimum size
|   `-- layoutScene: anchor changed subtree; push siblings right; validate composition
|-- DiagramConnection: anchors depend on parsed content nodes
|   |-- source: content-node anchor; target: content-node or box anchor
|   |-- create/update validates changed endpoints against current content
|   |-- reconcileConnections(before, after, edges, nodeIds)
|   |   |-- deleted endpoint placement -> remove incident edge
|   |   |-- proven node correspondence -> rebase node and revision IDs
|   |   `-- otherwise preserve stale anchor rather than guess a new endpoint
|   `-- edits reconcile anchors; patches also remap jumps, collapse state and sections
|-- CanvasView: named saved states and branches owned by CanvasHistory
|   |-- saved metadata lives outside the state restored by undo/apply
|   |-- create/save -> pin current checkpoint as saved endpoint
|   |-- open -> stash current working copy; resume target working copy or saved endpoint
|   |-- fork -> create and open child from parent's saved checkpoint
|   |-- alternatives -> create grouped children from ONE pinned saved checkpoint
|   |-- keep -> save candidate; archive group siblings and their descendants
|   |-- discard -> archive target and descendants; delete requires a leaf
|   |-- recording: start -> collect visited checkpoints -> stop saves endpoints
|   |-- comparison reads only pinned baseline/proposed endpoints and their dependencies
|   |-- dirty compares document, bindings and view state excluding viewport/selection
|   `-- generation -> validate finished proposal; update candidate without switching head
|
`-- CanvasTransfer: isolated preparation; workspace publication is an external contract
    |-- require another destination and a nonempty, unique selection of diagram placements
    |-- preserve relative placement; remap IDs, content, highlights and links as needed
    |-- copy
    |   |-- allocate fresh placement/content IDs; retain sharing within the copied selection
    |   |-- copy edges only when both endpoints are selected
    |   `-- append/link destination checkpoint; source history remains unchanged
    |-- move
    |   |-- preserve IDs where destination has no collision
    |   |-- remove selected source placements and content no longer used there
    |   |-- convert source canvas edges into canvas jumps; redirect moved targets
    |   `-- append/link both source and destination checkpoints
    `-- coordinated undo/redo
        |-- both canvases must be at the expected transaction boundaries
        `-- prepare navigation: both histories for move; destination only for copy
            `-- ordinary history-service navigation rejects linked transfer checkpoints

Command execution and publication
|-- Public entry points converge on private applyOperations
|   |-- transact -> applyUpdate -> settle driver -> check version
|   |   `-- nonempty API batch: 1..100 operations
|   `-- commitEditorGesture uses current version and supplied canvas
|       |-- nonempty native batch: 1..10000 operations
|       `-- empty batch calls updateSnapshot directly
|-- Staging owns a cloned document and canvas
|   |-- sequential operations read preceding staged revisions
|   |-- patch/revision edits accumulate node correspondence
|   `-- native grid moves defer layout until the batch ends
|-- Context commands have a separate data dependency
|   `-- context-set requires matching diagram identity,
|       revision ID and source fingerprint
|-- Private updateSnapshot finishes the publication path
|   |-- normalize selection and diagram views; resolve floating geometry
|   |-- historyService.append receives accumulated correspondence
|   `-- publish snapshot version/checkpoint -> notify subscribers
`-- Publication guarantee has a defined boundary
    |-- failed validation prevents the staged checkpoint publication
    |-- settling a pending gesture happens before the version check
    `-- revision helpers run during staging; full rollback is not shown

History ownership, retention and persistence
|-- Controller owns its runtime handle; service hides the history
|   |-- openContext freezes a new handle object
|   |-- WeakMap keys by object identity, not persisted contextId
|   `-- equal context IDs can therefore have isolated histories
|-- CanvasHistory privately owns record, validation cache and changes
|   |-- checkpoints store placement root separately from bindings
|   |-- bindings retain issued revisions and required dependencies
|   |-- reviews, selections and alternatives also pin revisions
|   `-- edit after undo clears future; archived records remain
|-- Revision ancestry has an explicit boundary
|   |-- initial append can record parent identity without ancestry
|   `-- current-only export keeps head dependencies and boundary IDs
|-- Restoration can validate lazily
|   |-- default 'all' checks the supplied archive
|   `-- 'current' checks head dependencies; navigation validates targets
|-- Persistence is separate from navigation
|   |-- persistenceChanges(since) returns header plus accumulated deltas
|   |-- checkpoint encoder supplies storage records
|   `-- saved views/recording force a full export
`-- Checkpoint metadata is not absolutely immutable
    |-- linkTransaction replaces transactionId under the same checkpoint ID
    `-- retireTransactions removes links and records changed snapshots

Anchors depend on placement, revision and parsed nodes
|-- Resolved content anchor
|   |-- displayNodeId -> diagram placement -> contentId
|   `-- content revisionId + contentNodeId -> current parsed node
|-- create/update checks endpoints independently
|   |-- changed endpoint must identify current content
|   `-- unchanged endpoint may retain a different, stale revision
|-- reconcileConnections preserves only supported correspondence
|   |-- missing endpoint placement -> remove the edge
|   |-- already-stale revision -> keep anchor unchanged
|   |-- supplied node map with a current node -> rebase IDs
|   |-- same ASCII and structure kind -> match line/start column
|   `-- no match -> preserve stale anchor
|-- Checkpoint encoding uses logical nodeRefs
|   |-- binding selects revision; nodeRefs maps concrete node to logical ID
|   |-- canonical edge drops its content revisionId
|   `-- failed encoding saves original anchor in unresolvedAnchors
|-- documentFromHistory reverses this dependency
|   |-- placement + binding + revision table identify the revision
|   |-- reverse nodeRefs lookup reconstructs concrete anchor
|   `-- unresolvedAnchors restores the original stale endpoint
`-- Patch correspondence also updates dependent state
    |-- mapped nodes reanchor edges and collapsed content nodes
    |-- active jumps require mapped lines and any required mapped node
    `-- section is dropped if either endpoint line has no mapping

Placement sharing and geometry
|-- Content and placement have different identities
|   |-- multiple diagram boxes may reference one contentId
|   |-- duplicate-instance shares content and copies its view state
|   `-- duplicate requires a parent; root diagram cannot use this path
|-- resolveScene measures without changing input
|   |-- parent origin + relative position -> absolute bounds
|   |-- expanded container size encloses its measured children
|   `-- collapsed box requires summary content
|       `-- hides children and ignores reserved minimum size
|-- layoutScene settles each expanded container
|   |-- child containing changedId comes first
|   |-- remaining order: column, row, original index
|   |-- only overlapping row spans need horizontal separation
|   `-- push right past settled obstacles, including configured gap
|-- composeScene verifies and renders the result
|   |-- rejects sibling overlap and out-of-range extents
|   |-- printable ASCII + LF; extent at most 20000 cells
|   `-- width * height must not exceed 4000000 cells
`-- Coordinate conversion is explicit
    |-- grid bounds: zero-based cells; right/bottom exclusive
    |-- hitTest: deepest hit with box-local cell coordinates
    `-- projectMapping: one-based source spans -> scene cell bounds

Saved branches and generation lifecycle
|-- CanvasHistory owns saved metadata outside restored state
|   |-- start/final IDs and checkpoint sequence pin saved endpoints
|   `-- activeViewId + workingCopies track unsaved branch progress
|-- openCanvasView branches on the active view
|   |-- already active -> stash only; no target restoration
|   `-- different view -> validate target, stash current, clone target
|       `-- fresh checkpoint; current camera retained; transfer link removed
|-- Alternative branches start from one saved endpoint
|   |-- alternatives: 1..10 unique names; live head unchanged
|   |-- fork opens its new child
|   `-- keep saves chosen child and archives group siblings/descendants
|-- Generation has stronger identity and state checks
|   |-- startGeneration: 1..8 distinct candidate IDs
|   |-- normal start pins parent's saved endpoint and dependencies
|   |-- optional pinned record supports replay after parent changes
|   |-- update requires matching runId and chatId on an available view
|   |-- only status 'finished' may publish a proposed history
|   |-- validate proposal and merged record; reject conflicting revisions under existing IDs
|   `-- advance saved candidate endpoint without moving live head
|-- Settled generation accepts an identical status update only
|-- Running generation blocks relevant view edits/archive operations
`-- Recording collects appended or visited checkpoint IDs
    |-- stop pins endpoints; cancel removes metadata but retains edits
    `-- dirty comparison excludes viewport and selection

Transfer preparation and coordinated navigation
|-- prepareCanvasTransfer constructs isolated source/destination histories
|   |-- selection must contain unique diagram placements
|   |-- expand ancestor containers to measure selected absolute positions
|   `-- normalize positions by selection's minimum column and row
|-- Identity rules preserve sharing within the selection
|   |-- copy allocates fresh placement/content IDs
|   |-- move keeps IDs only where destination has no collision
|   `-- one contentId map prevents cloning shared content twice
|-- Link handling differs by operation
|   |-- copy retains edges only when both endpoints are selected
|   |   `-- copied content endpoints must validate as current
|   `-- move validates and converts ALL source edges to jumps
|       |-- includes edges with neither endpoint selected
|       |-- jump follows its source; moved targets are redirected
|       `-- source edge list becomes empty
|-- Destination merge calls placeTransferredGroup
|   |-- uses existing expanded root or wraps it in a new container
|   `-- placement helper's algorithm is outside the supplied sources
|-- Transaction records before/after checkpoint IDs on both sides
|   |-- destination gets a linked checkpoint for copy and move
|   `-- source gets a linked checkpoint only for move
`-- prepareTransferNavigation requires both boundaries, even for copy
    |-- reject discarded; undo needs applied=true, redo needs applied=false
    |-- newer edits on either side -> reject
    |-- navigate source only for move; always navigate destination
    `-- return prepared states; workspace publication is outside this input
